# S.10 Minimum UI/UX checklist

## Owner
Shared (used by: A3,A5,A8)

## Stage
Plan

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
—

## Input (reads)
UI baseline or built screens

## Steps
1. Check one primary action per screen.
2. Check loading, empty, error, offline and permission states.
3. Check labels, touch targets (44 pt iOS, 48 dp Android, 24 CSS px web), contrast 4.5:1, text scaling, feedback.
4. Record pass or fail per item

## Output (writes)
Checklist result per screen

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/design/<ID>/ui-checklist.md`

## Verification
Every item has pass or fail with evidence

## Checkpoints raised
- none
